what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 4-0 by roll call to give permission to post a part-time, hourly remote meeting coordinator position.
The committee re-held the vote because the revised agenda had not been posted at town hall after the prior meeting.
The position is unbenefited, works evenings, serves both the school department and the town, and runs remote meetings and trains users.
CARES Act funds pay for the position through December; after that it is paid from the local budget, with the cost shared between town and schools.

why_it_matters: From December to June the position moves from federal CARES Act money onto the local budget, mostly taxes, shared between the town and the schools rather than carried by the schools alone.
The re-vote shows that an agenda not posted at town hall can force a decision to be taken again, which affects whether remote meetings stay open to residents.
